instruction: The package `mistune` has a security vulnerability (CWE-79). A regression test describing the required secure behaviour has been added to the repository. Modify the package source so the test passes while keeping existing behaviour intact. Do not edit tests.

advisory.details: mistune.py in Mistune 0.7.4 allows XSS via an unexpected newline (such as in java\nscript:) or a crafted email address, related to the escape and autolink functions.

fix_commit.message:
Fix bypassing XSS vulnerability. Bypasing with newline. Old: >>> markdown('''[aa](java ... script:alert`1`;)''') '

aa

\n' New: >>> markdown('''[aa](java ... script:alert`1`;)''') '

aa

\n' Bypassing with malicious mail address. Old: >>> markdown('<"\nonclick="alert(1);>') '

"\nonclick="alert(1);

\n' New: >>> markdown('<"\nonclick="alert(1);>') '

"\nonclick="alert(1);

\n'
